Fifth development release of 0.18.0: DWG floor plans on every install, a Tasks tab on object pages, search boxes on long tables, and picking several objects at once.

> [!CAUTION]
> **This is a development release. It is not stable and it contains bugs.** Do not run it in production or on data you can't restore. Take a backup before upgrading a test install, and expect behaviour to change before 0.18.0. If you run into a problem, please [submit a bug report](https://github.com/danbyte-net/danbyte/issues/new?template=bug_report.md) - every report helps get 0.18.0 right.

Everything in [0.18.0-dev1](https://github.com/danbyte-net/danbyte/releases/tag/v0.18.0-dev1) through [0.18.0-dev4](https://github.com/danbyte-net/danbyte/releases/tag/v0.18.0-dev4) is included; read their notes for the full list.

### Features

- **DWG drawings work on every install:** the converter ships in the release bundle (static LibreDWG `dwg2dxf`, with its licence and source), so fresh installs and bundle upgrades need no setup, airgapped ones included. Source checkouts build it with `make cad-tools`; a set `DANBYTE_CAD_CONVERTER` still wins.
- **Tasks tab on object pages** lists the open tasks linked to the object. A linked task past its due time shows a warning to its assignees, which each can dismiss until the due date moves.
- **Search boxes on long detail tables:** a rack's devices, a virtualization source's VMs, hosts and review, device interfaces, change logs and about 50 other tabs. The search matches what the table shows, including related names.
- **Pick several objects at once** with the checkbox picker when linking objects to a task, marking maintenance impact, adding SLA members, adding ARP sources and assigning IPs to a DNS name.

### Fixed

- **Status changes made by bulk edit show by name in the change log,** like a single edit, including entries already logged.
- **IP status pickers list only statuses offered to IP addresses,** as every other status picker does.

### Upgrades

- **An empty `DANBYTE_CAD_CONVERTER` now means the bundled DWG converter;** set it to `off` to keep refusing DWG uploads.
- The release bundle is about 16 MB larger: it carries the DWG converter and its source.
